settings.subtitle: Minimal comfort at the dining table: an S-curve backrest, responsive tension tilting and a waterfall seat in a clean dining silhouette.

settings.heading: SIDIZ MANE Dining Chair
settings.body:
• Ergonomic S-Curve backrest - supports the spine's natural curve completely, holding posture upright and comfortable.
  • Flexible tension tilting - responds softly to your movement, easing lumbar fatigue through meals and daily life.
  • A pressure-easing waterfall seat - the front edge slopes away so circulation flows freely through long sittings.

A dining interior chair with the fit of an ergonomic seat and the footprint of a dining classic.

settings.subtitle: Minimal comfort
settings.heading: MANE
settings.alt: SIDIZ MANE dining chairs at a table
settings.description:
The SIDIZ MANE pairs a composed design with S-curve ergonomics that support the spine - comfort with nothing wasted.

Tension tilting, rare in a dining chair, responds softly as you move, and the waterfall seat keeps pressure off the legs through long sittings.

*Dimensions are measured with nobody seated.
*Seat height is measured at the centre of the seat.
